sources.title: RULER: What’s the Real Context Size of Your Long-Context Language Models?
sources.version: arXiv:2404.06654v3 [cs.CL], 6 Aug 2024; Published as a conference paper at COLM 2024
sources.authority_reason: Original benchmark paper by Hsieh, Sun, Kriman, Acharya, Rekesh, Jia, Zhang, and Ginsburg; NVIDIA affiliation verified on original first page.
sources.inspection_note: First-page identity; abstract; section 3 introduction and sections 3.1–3.4 including Table 2; section 4 Models & Inference setup and Task configurations. Searches also exposed unrelated official-paper result snippets; no repository author summary was used. Permanent snapshot: docs/technical-reviews/artifacts/phase4-a_9-independent-20261005/sources/ruler-2404.06654v3.pdf. Single, multi-values, multi-queries retrieval; multi-hop tracing; aggregation; QA; answer-presence recall is not a no-extras/order criterion. No published model score is used as a course-model result.

sources.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
sources.authority_reason: Original paper by Liu, Lin, Hewitt, Paranjape, Bevilacqua, Petroni, and Liang; original author affiliations verified on first page.
sources.inspection_note: First-page identity and abstract; section 2 and section 2.1 complete setup paragraphs, including annotated-answer selection and ambiguity footnote; section 2.2 decoding paragraph; section 3.1 synthetic key-value setup. Permanent snapshot: docs/technical-reviews/artifacts/phase4-a_9-independent-20261005/sources/lost-middle-2307.03172v3.pdf. Controlled multi-document QA selects one document with a NaturalQuestions annotated answer; distractors exclude annotated answers. Ambiguous reasonable alternatives can exist as stated in footnote 2. It does not test obligatory cross-document combination. Position and length are distinct controlled factors; inference uses greedy decoding.

sources.title: LongBench: A Bilingual, Multitask Benchmark for Long Context Understanding
sources.authority_reason: Original paper by Bai and coauthors; Tsinghua University, Zhipu.AI, and Institute of Automation affiliations verified on original first page.
sources.inspection_note: First-page identity and abstract; section 3.1 input/context/answer definition; section 3.2.1 multi-document QA and summarization paragraphs, including continuation on original PDF page 4. Not every task in this benchmark is a multi-hop task; no version-conflict benchmark claim is inferred.

sources.title: Independent derivation from exact current eight paper records
sources.details: A.8 T=攝影社→M17; U1=棋藝社→B04; U2=合唱社→C26; U3=M17→二樓; U4=B04→一樓; U5=C26→三樓; U6=美術社→E31; U7=E31→二樓. Expected single answer M17; ordered three answers [M17,B04,C26]; floor join T∘U3 gives 二樓. Required output-item counts are 1,3,1; the joined question needs 2 supporting records. Six candidate criteria and exact source parsing are preserved in oracle code/output.

claims.statement: A single answer-bearing clue tests specified information retrieval; finding M17 does not establish complete multi-item retrieval, linked-record answering, or all long-context understanding.
claims.location: A.9 title, opening, paragraphs on single and three-record retrieval, concluding scope paragraph and RULER supplement.
claims.scope: Task distinctions and the support limit of a successful single clue, not a claim about any course model or all model internals.

evidence.locator: Original PDF p.1 abstract; §3.1 pp.3–5; Table 2 p.4; §3.2–3.4 pp.5–6
evidence.supports: The original NIAH task retrieves one needle; multi-values/multi-queries require multiple answers; variable tracking follows linked assignments; aggregation and QA cover further requirements. These are distinct task behaviors.
Exactly the same paper context admits tasks with different required evidence and outputs.

claims.statement: The eight unchanged paper records entail M17 for the single question, the ordered M17/B04/C26 for the three-club question, and 二樓 from T with U3 for the floor question. M17/B04 omits C26; extra E31 belongs to 美術社; 一樓 is the U1/U4 path for 棋藝社; M17 alone does not answer a floor question.
claims.location: A.9 four-row table, three question examples, error examples, answer-summary table and linked-record figure.
claims.scope: Hand-checkable paper materials only. Eight material records are not an answer-score denominator. Output-item denominators are 1,3,1; floor-support count is 2. Extra/order checks implement this example’s stated criterion, not RULER recall scoring.

evidence.locator: Eight original table rows T,U1–U7 and joins T→M17→U3→二樓, U1→B04→U4→一樓
evidence.supports: Every asserted code, floor, distractor and required association follows from the exact supplied material.
Parses current/prerequisite rows and executes exact answer and omission/extra/order/duplicate/substitution assertions.

verification.expected: 8 records, of which A.9 displays 4; answers M17, [M17,B04,C26], 二樓. Omitting C26, adding E31, swapping order, duplicating or substituting a code must fail the complete ordered answer condition.
verification.observed: All assertions passed. Four club/code and four code/floor relations; exact expected answers. Only the correct candidate passes. Omission contains 2 of 3 required codes; extra and wrong-order candidates contain 3 of 3 codes but fail completion. U1/U4 yield 一樓 for 棋藝社, not 攝影社.
verification.details: Executed the standard-library-only oracle on saved exact source bytes. Rendered and viewed SVG matches the two original relation rows and final answer. No model output was generated.
verification.tolerance: Exact string/sequence/integer equality; no floating-point approximation.

claims.statement: The single question needs T; the three-club question needs T,U1,U2; the floor question needs both T and U3. Deleting U3 leaves no supported 攝影社 floor answer, while the code questions remain answerable. Short sufficient contexts and reordered relation placements preserve the paper answers.
claims.location: A.9 single-question explanation, linked floor explanation, and paragraph on preserving necessary records and short conditions.
claims.scope: Logical information sufficiency for the supplied records, not measured tokenizer lengths, generated-answer success or neural multi-hop computation.

evidence.locator: Exact relation domains in the A.8 eight-row table and A.9 requested fields
evidence.supports: No remaining row associates M17 with a floor when U3 is removed; an unrelated E31→二樓 does not fill the missing relation.
Executed sufficient-record short cases, both required-record deletions, and 8×7=56 placements of T/U3 among eight records.

verification.expected: Necessary short sizes 1,3,2 records respectively reproduce the three targets. Without U3 floor is unavailable, without T 攝影社 cannot be joined to a floor. Paper answers stay invariant under 56 placements of the two necessary relation rows.
verification.observed: Short cases returned the expected respective target; missing U3 preserved M17 and three-code list but floor=None; missing T gave floor=None; all 56 placements preserved the three answers and support labels.
verification.details: The None sentinel denotes unavailable logical evidence, not an observed failed model response. Moving records validates the answer oracle only; no equal-token or model position test was claimed.
verification.tolerance: Exact string, list, None and integer equality.

claims.statement: Future evaluation should keep the three task classes separate, vary length/position within each class, preserve all necessary information, hold token length and generation settings fixed for position comparisons, and use the same task in a short sufficient condition before attributing failures to long-distance evidence.
claims.location: A.9 paragraph beginning 真正評測時; A.8 controlled comparison and short-condition paragraphs.
claims.scope: A recommended controlled protocol. No already-executed tokenizer equality, model causal diagnosis, aggregate accuracy or long-context benchmark reproduction is claimed.

evidence.supports: The original method changes document/key position separately from context amount; it holds prompts/decoding method to standard settings and specifies a known answer-bearing unit.
Original benchmark first uses tasks manageable at short context and evaluates each task/length separately; its task-specific metrics and instances do not equate a single-clue score with all tasks.

evidence.locator: A.8 full-input token-count control; A.9 required-record paragraph; missing-U3/short variants
evidence.supports: The current manuscript explicitly requires serialization before counting tokens, preserves necessary rows, and distinguishes sufficient evidence from input-budget control.

claims.statement: Lost in the Middle’s controlled multi-document QA uses multiple documents but selects one document containing an annotated answer; the name alone does not imply required cross-document composition.
claims.location: A.9 source supplement, Lost in the Middle paragraph.
claims.scope: The controlled §2 setup and NaturalQuestions annotated-answer selection, not the paper’s separate §5 open-domain retrieval setting. Original footnote 2 allows ambiguous reasonable alternative answers in a small number of distractors.

evidence.locator: Original PDF §2 and §2.1 p.3, annotated-answer/distractor selection and footnote 2
evidence.supports: The input contains one annotated-answer document plus k−1 distractors filtered against annotated answers. The task asks access/use of that document, rather than joining two supporting documents.

claims.statement: Long-context work also includes summarization and multi-hop multi-document QA; the three code tasks do not validate these or version-conflict handling. LongBench covers summarization and multi-document datasets with multi-hop requirements.
claims.location: A.9 final scope paragraph and LongBench source supplement.
claims.scope: Benchmark task coverage and the toy material’s limited information requirements. No LongBench model scores, complete benchmark reproduction, or claim that LongBench evaluates version conflict is made.

evidence.locator: Original PDF §3.2.1 pp.3–4 (saved excerpts original lines 135–198,217–241; original first page lines 1–45)
evidence.supports: Multi-document QA includes HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA and MuSiQue. Summarization requires broader context and includes GovReport, QMSum, MultiNews, VCSUM.

evidence.locator: Original PDF §3.3 p.5 and Table 2 p.4
evidence.supports: Aggregation is explicitly introduced as a proxy for summarization, beyond one-needle retrieval.

evidence.locator: A.9 three specified questions; eight unique supplied association rows
evidence.supports: The specified code/floor answers check their requested records, not selection of important content or competing document versions.

factual_accuracy.details: The manuscript distinguishes retrieval, complete requested answers and linked evidence without treating a one-code success as full long-context ability; all exact examples match current records.

numeric_verification.details: Actual bounded CPU assertions passed for 8 original records, 4 displayed rows, 1/3/1 requested-output-item counts, 2 relation-support records, counterexamples and necessary-record removal. There are no empirical model-score denominators in A.9.

figure_consistency.details: Copied original SVG hash equals current SVG. Inkscape exit 0 rendered 1280×916 PNG, actually viewed. T→M17 and U3→二樓, common-code arrow and final 二樓 agree with the source. Text limits arrows to the illustrated answer relation.

source_verification.details: Personally inspected original HTTPS arXiv PDFs with exact v3/v3/v2 first-page versions. RULER distinguishes retrieval variants/tracing/aggregation/QA; Lost §2 controlled setup has one annotated-answer document; LongBench §3.2.1 includes multi-hop datasets and summarization. Compact LongBench original-text bytes and full original PDF SHA are recorded permanently.

limitations.details: Examples are hand-checkable materials and expectations, not model results. No GPU/training/model/data download or mature-model generation occurred. Position-placement calculations do not verify tokenizer equality or model response. Three tasks do not cover summaries/version conflicts. Same-owner stop/resume event is preserved; A.7 unrelated supplementary measurements were not used as A.9 evidence.
